name: bar-chart
title: Bar chart
description: A column chart with round-capped bars, a dot on today, an optional pale comparison bar, and day points grouped into weeks when the bars would get too thin; one Tab stop with arrow keys.

props.name: data
props.description: One object per period, oldest first: `{ label, title?, value, previous? }`.

props.name: label
props.description: The chart's accessible name, such as "Spending, last 7 days".

props.name: format
props.description: How values are written in the tooltip, the table and on the axis.

props.name: compare
props.description: Draw each point's `previous` value as a pale bar beside it, with a legend. Default false.

props.name: current
props.description: The index of the current point (today), marked with the signal dot. Default the last point; null for none.

props.name: height
props.description: The plot's height in px. Default 208, 170 when narrow, and lower in a compact tile.

props.name: minBarWidth
props.description: The thinnest a bar may be drawn, in px. Thinner bars are grouped instead. Default 10.

props.name: bucket
props.description: How many points make one group when bars get too thin, such as 7 for days into weeks. False never groups. Default 7.

props.name: bucketTitle
props.description: Names a group for the tooltip, the table and screen readers: "Week of 14 Sep". Gets the points and the first one's index.

props.name: bucketLabel
props.description: The short name under a group's bar. Default the first point's label.

props.name: tickEvery
props.description: Label every nth bar, counted back from the last. Default as many as fit, at most about ten.

props.name: loading
props.description: Show breathing skeleton bars instead of data.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown over the empty frame when there is no data or every value is 0, such as a message and a next step.

props.name: legend
props.description: Show the key under the chart: the series drawn and the current-point dot. Default on when there is a comparison or a current point to explain; a series that is not drawn is never listed.

props.name: activeIndex
props.description: The highlighted point (an index into `data`), or null. When grouped, the first index of the group.

props.name: defaultActiveIndex
props.description: The highlighted point to start with, when `activeIndex` is not controlled. Default null.

props.name: onActiveIndexChange
props.description: Called when hover, a finger or the keyboard picks another point, and with null when it lets go.

props.name: labels
props.description: Every visible and spoken string that is not data.

a11y.text: The plot is one Tab stop. ArrowLeft and ArrowRight, Home and End step through the bars without wrapping; Escape lets go. Hover and scrubbing show the same tooltip.

The plot is an image named by label and described by a hint ("Use the arrow keys to read each bar."). Each step is read once through a polite live region. A hidden table holds the whole series, and the tooltip is aria-hidden. While loading it is aria-busy with visually hidden loading text. With no data the plot has no role and is not focusable. minBarWidth groups bars into buckets, and the announcements read the buckets.
Under reduced motion the bars stand at full height at once.
